title: The Blue Glove
story: Someone left a blue glove on the classroom radiator. It was not there before lunch. Nia asked, but nobody claimed it. She noticed green paint on the thumb. The art group had painted posters that morning, and only Jules wore green paint. Nia found him in the hall. He checked his bag and saw one glove was missing. He thanked her and pulled the pair on.
